ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 1258 de 2008 (SAS regime); Código de Comercio Decreto 410 de 1971; Ley 526 de 1999 (UIAF – Colombian Financial Intelligence Unit); Decreto 1674 de 2016 (AML/CFT framework); SIC Circular Única Título IV (Chamber-registry AML obligations); Resolución SIC 367 de 2021 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – RUB).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-jurisdiction commercial registry or company registrar
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Colombia is a Hague Convention member)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation of each foreign shareholder
Notarized Special Power of Attorney (poder especial) appointing the Colombian incorporator or local counsel

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, legal representatives, and ultimate beneficial owners against UIAF administrative lists, OFAC SDN, United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, INTERPOL Red Notices, and Colombian national terrorism-financing lists; enhanced due diligence required on any PEP, adverse-media, or sanctions hit; screening must be refreshed at least every 180 days and before any material payout change.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) – www.rues.org.co, filed through the Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the registered office (recommended: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names may be registered in Spanish or in a foreign language using the Latin alphabet; the corporate designator 'S.A.S.' or the full phrase 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada' must terminate the name; foreign-language or transliterated terms must not create commercial confusion with protected trademarks; non-Latin scripts must be transliterated phonetically into Spanish-compatible spelling.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: TikTok (third-party trademark requiring express licensor authorization)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be renewed once by filing a fresh name-request through RUES. Upon rejection, the applicant may (i) file a reposición petition before the same Cámara de Comercio within 10 business days of notification, (ii) reserve an alternate objective name at no additional statutory cost, or (iii) lodge a recurso de apelación with the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) when the refusal is grounded on SIC criteria; all appeals are processed electronically through the RUES case-management module.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Accepted for SAS registration on condition that the virtual-office provider maintains a real physical premises within the chosen municipality, the address is capable of receiving judicial and administrative service of process, and a valid service contract is exhibited at the Cámara de Comercio; virtual offices are not recommended as the sole domicile for DIAN electronic-invoicing and payouts if platform KYC verification requires physical address evidence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low_05pct (approximately 5% during the first operating year); risk of unannounced inspection rises above baseline only if UBO filings become inconsistent, if the registered address is flagged as a mail-drop, or if the TikTok creator-payout volume triggers enhanced bank or DIAN administrative review.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law 1258 of 2008 (Ley 1258 de 2008) Articles 1, 5, 9 and 15; Colombian Commerce Code (Codigo de Comercio, Decreto 410 de 1971) Articles 110-112; Decreto 1074 de 2015 (sole regulatory decree of commerce)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Camara de Comercio de Bogota (Bogota Chamber of Commerce) - Registro Unico Empresarial (RUES) portal, under the functional oversight of the Superintendencia de Sociedades
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitucion (private incorporation instrument signed by the founding shareholder and attested before a Notario Publico); Escritura Publica No. ___ before a Notary is required only if real property is contributed to capital, per Law 1258 of 2008, Article 5
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital - the S.A.S. may be incorporated with COP 0 (Law 1258 of 2008, Art. 5); subscribed capital must be fully paid within two (2) years (Art. 9) and paid capital must be deposited into and certified by a Colombian financial institution before share certificates are issued
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 001 - The founding shareholder of [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S., having subscribed 100% of the authorized share capital, resolves: (1) to ratify the share subscription and the two-year paid-up capital schedule; (2) to adopt the registered office at [address], Bogota D.C., Colombia; (3) to appoint [NAME] as sole legal representative and general manager without power restrictions; (4) to appoint [NAME] as substitute legal representative; (5) to authorize the legal representative to open bank accounts, receive TikTok Creator Payout and Wise B2B transfers, execute the commercial registry filing, and obtain the RUT, zoning and fire-safety permits; and (6) to ratify all pre-incorporation acts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Availability Check and Reservation (Pre-Validation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Camara de Comercio de Bogota - RUES portal (www.rues.org.co) or in-person counter at the Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the requested corporate name (razon social) and up to three alternative names through the RUES system; the Chamber certifies availability against its trademark and corporate-name database; upon availability, the name is reserved for a non-extendable term of 30 days; the reservation certificate must accompany the incorporation filing.
required_dossiers: Application for name reservation with the proposed S.A.S. corporate name
Identification document of the founding shareholder
Tax identification number (if the founder is a legal entity)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, one or more alternative names may be filed; no penalty applies, but the 30-day reservation clock restarts once the name is approved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarized Execution of the Incorporation Instrument and By-Laws (Estatutos)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaria (Colombian notary public) selected by the founders, with the advice of a corporate attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Documento Privado de Constitucion containing the S.A.S. by-laws: corporate name, domicile, term, purpose covering ISIC 7310 MCN creator-representation activities, share classes, capital, board structure, legal-representative powers, audit rules and dissolution causes; execute the instrument before a notary to attest the founder's signature; if any contribution is real estate, use a public deed and pay the notary transfer tax.
required_dossiers: Name reservation certificate (Certificado de Reserva de Nombre)
Valid photo ID of the founding shareholder
Draft by-laws text (estatutos)
Proof of contribution (escrow deposit receipt) if capital is paid prior to execution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Notarial observations are typically formal; correct the drafting errors, re-sign the pages, and re-attest before the same notary within the validity of the name reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Filing with the Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Camara de Comercio de Bogota - Registry Office (Registro Mercantil), submission via RUES or in-person
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed incorporation instrument, the name reservation, the annexes (estado de solvencia), and the completed registration form via RUES or the Chamber counter; pay the registry fee by PSE bank transfer or in-person; receive a pre-registration review (control de legalidad) by the Chamber's legal staff; upon approval the Chamber issues the Certificado de Camara de Comercio evidencing the S.A.S. existence and the appointed officers.
required_dossiers: Notarized incorporation instrument (original and copy)
Name reservation certificate
Founding shareholder ID document
Pre-registration form (solicitud de matricula)
Proof of payment of the registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the Chamber issues an official rejection (via observaciones al documento), the founder must cure the defects within 30 days; if the capital is unpaid this is disclosed in the certificate; re-submission is online and the application number is kept.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration with DIAN - RUT and NIT
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Direccion de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - online portal (Sede Electronica) or DIAN central office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the application for inscription in the Registro Unico Tributario (RUT) with the Domicilio Fiscal (fiscal address) of the registered office; the DIAN assigns the NIT (Numero de Identificacion Tributaria); the S.A.S. is classified as a general taxpayer under the corporate income tax regime; the legal representative must register as the tax representative with digital certificate.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Camara de Comercio (post-registration)
Lease or proof of the fiscal address
ID and passport of the sole shareholder
Power of attorney granted to the legal representative (DIAN-approved form)
Bank account details for refund and deposit purposes (optional)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUT application bounces owing to address inconsistencies, correct the domicile with a new lease certificate and update the commercial registry through a reformation; re-file the RUT within the same fiscal day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Opening and Paid-in Capital Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized commercial financial institution (e.g., Bancolombia, Davivienda, BBVA Colombia) selected by the founders
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate checking and USD-facilitating account for the S.A.S.; deposit the paid-up capital subscription, if any; obtain the certificado de deposito for the paid-in capital; ensure the account is prepared to receive TikTok Creator Payout via Wise B2B international transfers (incoming remittance capacity).
required_dossiers: RUT and NIT certificate
Certificado de Camara de Comercio (not older than 30 days)
First Board Resolution with bank-account authorization
Valid IDs of the legal representative and substitute
Reference letter from an existing bank (when required by KYC policy)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: KYC queries (e.g., missing address or original IDs) are cured by presenting updated documents; if the bank declines the account, apply to a second bank; a rejection letter is not a registry obstruction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of Commercial Books (Libros de Comercio)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Camara de Comercio de Bogota - Book Registration Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present to the Chamber the following pre-bound books: book of shareholders' meetings (libro de actas), share registry book (registro de accionistas), and general accounting ledger (libro mayor and auxiliares); request the stamping (sello de registro) evidencing legalization; keep the stamped books available for fiscal inspection.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Camara de Comercio
Physical books duly bound
Inventory of books and company identification plate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If stamping is refused because the books are unbound or non-compliant with the technical standard (Resolucion 0002 de 2017), acquire new books, transfer the acts, and re-present.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Zoning Use Certificate (Certificado de Uso del Suelo)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Curaduria Urbana (zoning and urban standards) and the respective Local Mayor's Office (Alcaldia Local) of the registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the certificate confirming that the registered office's commercial or administrative use is compatible with the applicable land-use regulation (POT - Plan de Ordenamiento Territorial); this certificate is also required for the operating license and precedes the fire-safety inspection.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Camara de Comercio
Lease agreement or certified office ownership title
Description of the economic activity: advertising and creator-MCN agency - ISIC 7310
Location and measurement plan of the premises (plano de localizacion)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the activity is classified as incompatible, request a special use permit or relocate the registered office to an approved commercial district; partial rejections can be appealed before the Curaduria Urbana within the applicable legal term.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Fire Safety and Occupational Workplace Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cuerpo de Bomberos de Bogota (Fire Department) - inspection unit, and the ARL occupational risk insurer
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Request the fire-safety inspection of the office and obtain the Certificado de Bomberos evidencing compliance with emergency exits, extinguishers and signage; simultaneously affiliate the employer with an ARL, draft the Sistema de Gestion de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo (SG-SST) per Resolution 0312 of 2019, and obtain the occupational medical clearance for employees.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Camara de Comercio
Certificado de Uso del Suelo
Office lease and floor plan
Fire-safety equipment inventory (extinguishers, evacuation signage)
ARL affiliation contract and policy (plan y poliza)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Failures are listed in the inspection report; install the required equipment (extinguishers, emergency lighting, evacuation lights) and schedule a reinspection within 10 business days; temporary occupancy permits may be obtained for exceptional cases.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No sectoral industrial licensing board applies; the activity is a non-regulated professional services operation (creator-MCN agency). Pursuant to Colombian legislation, ISIC 7310 does not require a statutory operating license; local authorities (Alcaldia Local de Bogota) and the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Bogota issue non-sectoral occupancy permits.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Certificado de Uso del Suelo (zoning use certificate) and Certificado de Bomberos (fire-safety occupancy certificate) as municipal operational clearances

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Secretaria Distrital de Ambiente de Bogota (SDA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category III office-only activity: no full EIA study required for an administrative office under ISIC 7310; environmental registration is unnecessary given the absence of point-source emissions, process wastewater or hazardous waste generation (subject to Chamber registry classification).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: only domestic sewage to the public sewer, complying with Resolucion 631 de 2015 permissible limits (pH 6.0-9.0; BOD5 200 mg/L; TSS 100 mg/L as applicable); emissions: negligible VOCs in office setting, no industrial stack; solid waste segregated and handed over per Decreto 1076 de 2015; e-waste must be delivered to authorized collectors under Decreto 284 de 2018.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification by Cuerpo de Bomberos de Bogota (extinguishers, evacuation routes, emergency signage and structural load inspection for non-industrial occupancy), plus workplace medical clearance and implementation of the Sistema de Gestion de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo (SG-SST) under Resolucion 0312 de 2019.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – the unified national tax and customs authority. Official portal: https://www.dian.gov.co; transactional platform: MUISCA (https://muisca.dian.gov.co).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the S.A.S. before a Notary and register with the Cámara de Comercio; the single-window system transmits incorporation data to DIAN. Step 2: The legal representative obtains a DIAN-recognized digital certificate (firma electrónica) from an authorized certification authority. Step 3: Through MUISCA, complete the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) pre-registration, selecting 'Responsable de IVA' and 'Factura Electrónica de Venta' obligations, and obtain the definitive NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). Step 4: Foreign shareholders must file notarized powers of attorney, passport copies, and beneficial-owner declarations (SARLAFT/AML screening). Step 5: Foreign entities without a Colombian branch must appoint a local fiscal/statutory representative before the RUT can be activated for VAT and withholding purposes. NIT issuance is immediate online; RUT stamping follows within 24–48 hours.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; a Colombian S.A.S. is a capital-based company taxed at the entity level under the Estatuto Tributario with no pass-through transparency. Resident S.A.S. entities are taxed on worldwide income; foreign-source passive income may be exempt or taxable depending on applicable rules. The entity is a VAT responsible person for all taxable supplies and qualifies as an exporter for zero-rating purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia has no US-style check-the-box election; classification follows the Commercial Code and Estatuto Tributario. Available elections: (i) optional 'Régimen Simple de Tributación' (SIMPLES) substitute gross-receipts tax for entities with ordinary income ≤ 3,500 UVT (≈ COP 174.3 million in 2025); (ii) VAT export election to charge 0% IVA and claim monthly refund of input VAT on export-service activities; (iii) parent-subsidiary group consolidation regime (Articles 19 to 19-3 E.T.) subject to DIAN authorization; (iv) no hybrid-mismatch opt-in – OECD BEPS Action 2 rules per Law 2010 of 2019 are mandatory and disallow deductions on certain hybrid instruments.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre las Ventas) – Value Added Tax governed by Articles 420–481 of the Estatuto Tributario, complemented by national consumption and excise taxes.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary de-minimis threshold for legal entities: an S.A.S. performing any taxable supply of goods or services must register as a VAT responsible person (Responsable de IVA) from the commencement of activities, irrespective of turnover. The simplified VAT regime is reserved for individuals and is not available to companies. Optional SIMPLES small-taxpayer regime applies only up to 3,500 UVT of gross ordinary income (approximately COP 174,296,500 for tax year 2025; UVT 2025 = COP 49,799).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta – FEV) with real-time XML transmission to DIAN. Each invoice is transmitted through DIAN's REST/SOAP web-service APIs or a certified 'Proveedor Tecnológico', validated within seconds, and receives a CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) plus a QR code for invoices above 3 UVT. Since 2022 all VAT responsible taxpayers operate under the e-invoicing v2 scheme; DIAN rejection of non-compliant XML invalidates the invoice for the buyer's input VAT credit. For exports, the electronic export invoice must be issued before goods leave customs or before the service-rendering invoice is recorded; the FEV must be transmitted at transaction time or within the maximum 24-hour tolerance; local point-of-sale integration is mandatory for physical retail.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies under Articles 479 and 481 E.T. and Decree 1625 of 2016 (Articles 1.3.1.6.3–1.3.1.6.5). The MCN agency's creator-management, advertising placement, and talent-representation services qualify as exported services when: (i) the beneficiary and effective recipient is not domiciled in Colombia (e.g., a non-resident TikTok/Bytedance affiliate or foreign advertiser); (ii) the beneficial use, exploitation, or result of the service occurs exclusively abroad; (iii) the service is not intermediated to or enjoyed by a Colombian taxable person; (iv) the S.A.S. issues the corresponding electronic export invoice charging 0% IVA and presents the monthly VAT return (Form 330) reflecting the zero-rated operation; and (v) input VAT (19%) paid on local acquisitions of software, cloud services, equipment, and subcontractors is creditable and refundable through the 'solicitud de devolución' process in MUISCA. The exporter must maintain the DEX (for goods), the export service contract, and proof of foreign currency collection.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación – DEX / Form 264) stamped by DIAN customs for tangible goods; for MCN services, the export service contract and the electronic export invoice replace the customs declaration
Bill of Lading (ocean) or Air Waybill (air) evidencing physical export of goods; for services, a dated service agreement, scope of work, and delivery reports demonstrating foreign-locale benefit
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Canalización de Divisas) issued by the Colombian foreign-exchange intermediary bank, evidencing timely receipt and channelization of export proceeds
Electronic export invoice (Factura Electrónica de Venta Exportación) with CUFE and QR code accepted by DIAN
Certificate of tax residence / fiscal domicile of the foreign client (TikTok affiliate, brand advertiser, or offshore agency)
Substantiating documents for input VAT refund: supplier e-invoices, customs import declarations for inputs, payment evidence, and VAT ledgers
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN conducts risk-based audits of export VAT refunds, targeting repetitive refunds, related-party offshore transactions, mismatches between exchange declarations and e-invoice values, and untimely FX channelization. If zero-rating is rejected: (i) VAT is reassessed at 19% with monthly default interest (Banco de la República benchmark rate plus 50%); (ii) 'sanción por inexactitud' of up to 200% of the additional tax (Article 647 E.T.) applies; (iii) improperly refunded amounts are clawed back with a 'sanción de devolución improcedente' of up to 100% plus interest (Article 670 E.T.); (iv) criminal liability for 'obtención fraudulenta de devoluciones' under Law 1762 of 2015 (Código Penal Articles 402–406) carries 48–108 months imprisonment and fines up to 50% of the fraudulent amount; (v) false export declarations trigger customs smuggling penalties (Articles 463–466 C.P.). The DIAN's assessment period extends to six (6) years in cases of inexactitude (Article 706 E.T.), and the refund statute of limitations is generally five (5) years. The S.A.S. may also be flagged as a high-risk taxpayer, suspended from the automated refund channel, and subjected to an administrative freeze of refunds pending full verification.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia), acting jointly with the Comisión de Cambios (Foreign Exchange Commission) and the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia, which supervises the authorized Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario (IMCs); the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) enforces supporting foreign-trade and tax declarations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) operates under a free-market, floating exchange-rate regime based on the Representative Market Rate (TRM). Current-account operations are convertible without prior authorization but are subject to the mandatory channeling of qualifying export proceeds through an IMC. Capital-account operations, including inbound foreign direct investment (FDI), require no prior license but must be declared via the relevant Declaración de Cambio and registered with Banco de la República; timely FDI registration (within 12 months) is a substantive precondition for the lawful remittance of profits and repatriation of capital. Profit remittance to non-resident shareholders of an S.A.S. is permitted through an IMC subject to: (i) proof of prior FDI registration, (ii) statutory/audited financial statements evidencing distributable earnings, and (iii) withholding tax on dividends at 5% under Article 246 of the Colombian Tax Statute (subject to treaty relief). Practical hurdles include strict reconciliation of channeled funds against underlying service invoices, the 180-day channeling deadline for service export proceeds, and prudent segregation of FDI capital from operational flows to avoid misclassification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: All service-export proceeds of the Colombian S.A.S. (including TikTok creator-commission income) must be channeled through an IMC within 180 days (six months) from receipt of the foreign currency; for goods exports the term runs from the date of the export declaration (DEX). No mandatory conversion ratio to COP is imposed: the exporter may either sell the foreign currency to the IMC at market rate or deposit it into an individually registered foreign-currency compensation account (cuenta de compensación). Failure to channel within the statutory period constitutes an exchange-control infraction subject to fines by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia under the Régimen Cambiario.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (COP) with foreign-currency compensation module (cuenta de compensación)
Operational Account (COP) and corporate USD clearing via IMC
Operational Account (COP) and export-proceeds channeling platform
Institutional Operational Account (COP/USD) for high-volume cross-border treasury
Operational Account (COP) with digital FX and batch payment services
Operational Account (COP) and regional LatAm clearing support
Operational Account (COP) with North-American correspondent corridor

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW as a substitute for the regulated channeling route; MEDIUM as a supplemental low-value payout and collection rail. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise B2B, Payoneer, Airwallex) are not authorized Colombian IMCs and cannot legally discharge the foreign-exchange channeling obligation. They may be used for convenience (e.g., TikTok creator micro-payouts and aggregating receivables) provided that (i) foreign-currency balances are periodically repatriated or regularized through an IMC using Formulario 2 or Formulario 5, (ii) the Colombian S.A.S. retains full accounting and DIAN reporting traceability, and (iii) no export proceeds remain offshore beyond the 180-day channeling window unless held in a registered compensation account. Using such EMIs as the primary FX intermediary would trigger exchange-control sanctions and AML compliance deficiencies.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The prevailing standard for corporate treasury-grade accounts is physical appearance of the legal representative (or a locally appointed attorney-in-fact holding a notarized, apostilled power of attorney) before bank officers at the time of onboarding; the certified interview extends to the ultimate beneficial owners holding 5% or more of the S.A.S. Remote or video KYC is generally accepted only as a supplementary verification layer, not as a substitute for the physical meeting for first-time corporate clients. Non-resident directors may delegate banking representation to a Colombian resident attorney-in-fact, and corporate documents issued abroad must be apostilled and translated into Spanish by a certified translator.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly incorporated S.A.S. without audited financial history or operational track record
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificado de existencia y representación legal issued by the Cámara de Comercio within the last 30 days; notarized bylaws (estatutos); opening balance sheet prepared by a certified public accountant; detailed business plan evidencing TikTok MCN contracts; commercial lease or office invoice; identity documents and tax registration (RUT) of the legal representative and directors.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity in beneficial ownership chain due to intermediate foreign holding entities or nominee directors
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete ownership chart signed by the ultimate natural persons; apostilled certificates of good standing of foreign shareholders; identification of every individual holding at least 5%; sworn declaration of source of funds; tax-residence certificates (CRS self-certification or W-8/W-9 forms); annotated shareholder registry (libro de accionistas).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency micro-inflows from TikTok creator payouts creating unusual transaction patterns versus standard invoice-based collections
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Batch reconciliation files from TikTok Creator Payout statements; underlying MCN/creator services agreements and IP assignments; AML-SARLAFT manual with digital-platform typology; transaction monitoring policy; client due-diligence file on significant creators; registered compensation account evidencing channeling discipline.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Retention of foreign currency abroad or delayed channeling of service-export proceeds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: IMC-issued channeling certificates (Formulario 2 or Formulario 5); monthly FX ledger reconciliation; aged accounts-receivable report; registration certificate of the compensation account with Banco de la República; proof of observance of the 180-day channeling deadline; internal FX compliance procedure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound FDI from a jurisdiction perceived as high-risk or with unclear source of funds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank statements and source-of-wealth documentation of the foreign investor; executed capital contribution minutes and share subscription agreements; notarized and apostilled identity documents; completed Declaración de Cambio por Inversión Internacional (Formulario 4) filed through the IMC; proof of FDI registration with Banco de la República within 12 months.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: the foreign parent wires USD via SWIFT MT103 to the Colombian S.A.S.'s COP treasury account or compensation account held with an IMC; the remittance field states 'Aporte de capital social – [Shareholder Name] – [NIT]' and must not be mixed with trade payments. The receiving IMC files the Declaración de Cambio por Inversión Internacional (Formulario 4) using the exchange concept code for direct investment in the country; registration of the FDI with Banco de la República must be completed within 12 months of the contribution. Verification steps: (i) reconcile the credited amount against the capital contribution minutes and share subscription schedule; (ii) update the corporate capital record with the Cámara de Comercio where applicable; (iii) retain the IMC's exchange-rate (TRM) confirmation and the Formulario 4 receipt as the audit trail. A statutory capital escrow is not required in Colombia; any escrow arrangement is purely contractual.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 (Single Customer Credit Transfer) executed through the IMC for semi-annual, quarterly, or monthly settlements with foreign creators; for high-volume repetitive micro-payouts the S.A.S. may aggregate instructions via the bank's batch/payroll rail or use a fintech intermediary (e.g., Wise B2B) as an auxiliary channel. Each outbound creator payment is classifiable as an import of services and must be supported by the underlying contract/invoice and the Declaración de Cambio (Formulario 2 – importación de servicios) filed by the IMC at execution; batch schedules are acceptable for recurring payments. Payment memos should include invoice references and the SWIFT 'SI' (services) purpose-code taxonomy to prevent reconciliation flags. Commercial letters of credit are not standard for digital service/creator payouts; where documentary assurance is requested, a clean or standby L/C issued by an IMC may be used, but MT103 remains the cost-efficient operational rail.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: COP/USD deliverable and non-deliverable forwards (Forwards TRM) executed with authorized IMCs under master ISDA/ICOM documentation with evidenced underlying trade exposure.
Cross-currency swaps (FX swaps / CCS) with authorized IMCs to hedge mismatches between USD-denominated TikTok inflows and COP expenditure.
Over-the-counter FX options with authorized IMCs for performance-based hedging of conversion-rate volatility.
Offshore NDFs, admissible only to the extent the Colombian S.A.S. demonstrates underlying economic exposure and the domestic banking line is unavailable or insufficient.

Natural hedging strategy: retaining USD receivables in a registered compensation account (cuenta de compensación) to offset USD-denominated creator payout obligations and reduce forced conversion frequency.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (Annual renewal of commercial registration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered business domicile (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, no later than March 31 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal results in a surcharge on the registry tariff; continued non-renewal for two consecutive years may trigger administrative cancellation of the mercantile registration and loss of status as a registered merchant.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Acta de Asamblea de Accionistas y Estados Financieros (Approved shareholders' meeting minutes and annual financial statements)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered business domicile
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Financial statements must be approved by the shareholders' meeting within three months after the fiscal year end (March 31 for calendar-year entities); filed with the Cámara de Comercio within one month after approval (April 30 for calendar-year entities)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deposit the approved financial statements with the Cámara de Comercio may result in fines imposed by the Superintendencia de Sociedades and creates an impediment to the renewal of the commercial registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (Form 210 – Corporate Income Tax Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual deadline set by DIAN under the national tax calendar, generally between August 10 and September 9 based on the last two digits of the NIT for calendar-year entities; exact date must be confirmed against the DIAN filing schedule
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing incurs an extemporaneous filing fine of up to 5% of the tax paid or taxable assessable base, plus default interest and indexed monetary penalties; continuous non-filing may lead to administrative asset risk and criminal tax exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – actualización anual (Annual beneficial ownership update to the RUBF)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually as determined by DIAN's filing calendar, falling within three months after the fiscal year-end; immediate update required within 15 working days of any material change in beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to timely file or update the RUBF results in monetary fines under DIAN Penalty Regulations; persistent non-compliance can lead to a formal warning, forced compliance, and negative risk rating with the tax administration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Compulsory Revisor Fiscal (statutory auditor) appointment is triggered when, at the close of the immediately preceding fiscal year, the company has total assets or gross annual income exceeding the threshold set by Article 203 of the Colombian Commercial Code (currently 5,000 times the monthly statutory minimum wage; approximately COP 6,500 billion for fiscal year 2024). Mandatory audit also applies if the S.A.S. is specifically subject to permanent government supervision by the Superintendencia de Sociedades or is otherwise listed by law as requiring a statutory auditor.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian GAAP under Decreto 2420 of 2015 and its subsequent amendments; private entities that are not part of Group 1 generally apply the IFRS-adapted framework for SMEs, while larger enterprises converged to full IFRS as permitted by local regulation.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under DIAN Resolution 164/2021 establishing the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUBF), the S.A.S. must annually confirm the identity of all beneficial owners, including any individual who directly or indirectly owns or controls 5% or more of the capital or voting rights. The annual confirmation is filed electronically with DIAN within the prescribed calendar window; share transfers that alter the beneficial ownership percentage must be reflected both in the statutory shareholder register and reported via an updated RUBF filing within 15 working days of the transfer.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Colombian tax law provides no general territorial tax holiday for MCN/creator-economy services. The 'Régimen Simple de Tributación SIMPLE' allows a combined preferential income tax rate between 1.4% and 14.5% (depending on activity-based gross revenue bands for years 2024–2026) for qualifying small entities, but it excludes entities earning foreign-source income attributable to software/digital services unless specifically enumerated. For a standard S.A.S. under the general regime, the headline 35% rate applies; a temporary 'surcharge' on financial/energy entities is irrelevant to the business scope. No permanent establishment relief or patent-box deduction applies to creator incubation. Foreign tax credits (Art. 254 E.T.) are available for taxes paid abroad on foreign-source income, subject to substance limits and DTA tie-breaker rules.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 210 (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios) / DIAN electronic filing portal (Muisca – Servicios Informáticos Electrónicos), with mandatory digital signature via DIAN habilitated software or authorized filer.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing is due by the dates published by the DIAN each year (typically between 30 and 40 calendar days after each lodgement deadline cycle), determined by taxpayer tax ID ending digit and whether the filer is a legal entity or individual; in practice, for S.A.S. entities the deadline falls approximately 2.5 to 3.5 months after the fiscal year-end (fiscal year-end is 31 December unless the company’s annual accounts adopt a different permitted year-end under commercial law).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax identification number of the S.A.S. (NIT provided by DIAN).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owner must report the Colombian NIT of the entity; foreign owner’s own foreign TIN is not entered in this box unless the foreigner has a Colombian NIT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable year for which the return is filed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Colombian fiscal period (01 Jan – 31 Dec) of the S.A.S.; if the entity was incorporated mid-year, enter the short taxable period.
Select original return or corrective return under the statutory amendment rules (corrección voluntaria or provocada).
Only income derived from activities performed in Colombia; MCN/agency fees from domestic creators are Colombian-source.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form 210 – Box 28 (Ingresos brutos de fuente extranjera)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income from foreign sources (e.g., TikTok global creator monetization pass-throughs, foreign commission receivables).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owner must ensure transfer pricing consistent attribution of foreign-source revenues; cross-border fees are generally foreign-source if the performance/exploitation occurs abroad, with DIAN source rules under Arts. 24-25 E.T.
Non-resident filer must substantiate costs with invoices and supporting evidence of the underlying service delivery; no automatic apportionment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Administrative expenses, including salaries, rents, software, marketing, legal and tax services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only expenses related to Colombian-source activity and economically necessary are deductible; expenses paid to foreign related parties require TP documentation and withholding tax compliance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form 210 – Box 48 (Ingresos no constitutivos de renta ni ganancia ocasional)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income not constituting taxable income or occasional gain (e.g., certain dividends received from Colombian entities, capital reimbursements).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: MCN pass-through of creator earnings classified as receivables/agency collections may be excluded if strictly held as intermediary; failing documentation triggers inclusion.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net ordinary taxable income after deductions and exemptions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must reconcile with audited financial statements under IFRS; any non-compliant transfer pricing adjustment increases this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net losses for the fiscal period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses from foreign-source MCN activities can offset domestic gains only if sourced consistently and supported by transfer pricing analysis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income subject to the general 35% rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident-owned S.A.S. must compute on entity-level basis; branch-level concepts do not apply.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Withholdings and prepayments already paid during the year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign shareholders’ Colombian withholding tax on dividends is not creditable against the entity’s prepayments; only actual stamp duty, VAT self-withholdings and income tax prepayments apply.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total income tax due after credits and prepayments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders do not settle this tax; the S.A.S. domiciled in Colombia pays the tax out of its own assets before any distribution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form 210 – Box 112 (Pagos año anterior – obligaciones adicionales)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Recapitulation of prior-year payments and self-payments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure the DIAN’s own prepayment assessments match the entity’s accounts to avoid penalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty is 5% of the tax due for each month or fraction of month of delay (up to 100% of the tax), but never less than 10 UVT (approx. COP 470,000 in 2024, adjusted annually). Late payment interest (intereses moratorios) accrues at the effective DIAN lending rate plus 50% of the bank credit interest rate, recalculated monthly. Additionally, for failing to file (omisión de declaración), DIAN may impose a penalty of 20% of the greater of the tax due or the assessed taxable income (when the return was omitted), with potential criminal exposure under Colombian Criminal Code for evasion if the amount exceeds 200 minimum monthly wages. ERP and electronic invoicing failures add separate fines of up to 2,000 UVT.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 35% on distributions to non-resident shareholders: (i) First, dividends paid out of profits that have already borne Colombian corporate tax are subject to a 35% dividend withholding tax for non-resident beneficial owners (Art. 245 E.T.), except where (ii) the distribution is treated as a dividend in kind or the entity has applied the special imputation regime; the effective combined burden on corporate profits is approximately 57.75% before treaty relief. Dividends paid to Colombian resident individuals/entities are generally excluded from taxable income for the recipient but remain subject to the same 35% WHT when paid to a non-resident. If the S.A.S. opts or qualifies under the SIMPLE regime, the dividend WHT rate is 3% on distributed profits, but such regime is normally unavailable for a global MCN agency with cross-border service revenues.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Colombia’s double tax conventions generally reduce the dividend WHT to 0%, 5%, or 15% depending on the treaty partner and shareholding percentage (e.g., DTA Chile (0% for ≥60% holding with substance requirement); Mexico, Korea, Portugal, Spain (5%–10% depending on make-up); Canada, India, Czech Republic, Switzerland, UK, Brazil–Sweden? not all in force; DTA network includes roughly 15 treaties). Protocol: (1) Confirm the treaty is in force and the shareholder is resident in the treaty country with a valid Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) issued by the foreign tax authority for the calendar year in which the dividend is declared; (2) Submit to the Colombian payor or the DIAN, upon request, the TRC, Formulario de Declaración de Beneficiario Final (or equivalent sworn statement of beneficial ownership), and an explanation of the ownership chain showing no substance-less conduit arrangement; (3) The Colombian withholding agent applies the reduced rate only once the TRC and a signed declaration (Formato 110 or the standard DIAN annex) are delivered before the payment date; if documentation is received late, the excess WHT may be recovered via a refund request before the DIAN (devolución y compensación) with terms of 30–45 days plus interest after the complete filing; (4) For distributions to a shareholder in a non-treaty jurisdiction or to a transparent/flow-through entity without treaty entitlement, the statutory 35% rate applies, and the Colombian court doctrine of 'beneficial ownership' will deny treaty relief where the ultimate owner is not resident in the treaty state.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties for IP rights (software licenses, trademark, creator-brand intangibles) paid to non-residents: statutory withholding tax is 15% on the gross payment (Art. 408 E.T.) plus a remittance tax (impuesto de remesas) of 25% was abolished for income accrued in 2018 onward, but a 15% national income tax at source applies to the deemed Colombian-source income of the foreign beneficiary; additional local taxation can bring effective rate up to 15%–20% for benefits rendered in Colombia. Interest paid to non-residents on cross-border loans: statutory WHT is 35% on gross interest (Art. 402 E.T.), but the rate is reduced to 5% for loans granted by foreign financial institutions and registered as external credit (crédito externo) before Banco de la República, provided the lender’s jurisdiction has no preferential tax regime; treaty rates for interest are generally 0%–10% (e.g., 10% under Mexico, Korea, Portugal; 0% for certain interbank loans). Royalty treaty rates are typically 10% or 10%–15% (Mexico 10%, Korea 10%, Portugal 10%, Spain 10%, Switzerland 10%, Canada 10%, India 10%, Czech 10%, UK 10%). All payments to related parties require contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation to substantiate the arm’s length amount before claiming the reduced treaty rate or tax deduction.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Taxpayers with gross income exceeding 135,000 UVT (approx. COP 6,300 million for 2024, equivalently US$1.5M–1.6M depending on exchange rate) or net assets exceeding 135,000 UVT, or whose transactions with related parties exceed 45,000 UVT (approx. COP 2,100 million), are required to prepare and file the Informe de Operaciones con Vinculados (Local File generally integrated as Annex 6 / 'Anexo de TP') with the annual income tax return. A Master File (Declaración Informativa, Reporte País por País) is required for groups with consolidated revenue above 81,000,000 UVT (approx. COP 3.78 trillion) under OECD/BEPS Action 13. For a global TikTok MCN S.A.S., even below the thresholds, any cross-border transaction with a related creator entity, TikTok subsidiary, or foreign IP-owning affiliate must be benchmarked; documentation is imposed by DIAN through Resolution 000126/2021. If the company uses the SIMPLE regime, TP requirements are substantially simplified, but the standard S.A.S. remains fully subject to Arts. 260-11 to 260-17 E.T.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: Transactional Net Margin Method (Método de Margen Neto Transaccional)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not have a general Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) regime in the common-law sense, but anti-abuse doctrines and 'sustancia económica' are applied through (i) the GAAR (Norma General Antiabuso, Arts. 869-2 E.T.), empowering DIAN to recharacterize transactions lacking business purpose; (ii) the beneficial ownership condition under all Colombian DTAs; (iii) the subcapitalization rules (thin capitalization limit of 3:1 debt-to-equity for payments to foreign related lenders); (iv) CFC rules (Régimen de Compañías Controladas en el Exterior, Arts. 880-1 to 880-4 E.T.) attracting foreign passive income of controlled entities to taxation in Colombia at 35%; and (v) the requirement that the MCN agency actually carry out the core creator-incubation and monetization functions—owning contracts, managing creator relationships, bearing commercial risk, paying local payroll, and maintaining premises and staff—before attributing foreign income or claiming treaty benefits or exemptions. Judicial doctrine in Consejo de Estado has consistently disregarded shell intermediaries lacking economic substance when the real transaction is directly with the foreign principal.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion (Omisión de activos / inexistencia de operaciones, Arts. 402 Código Penal; 88, 647 E.T.)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting TikTok creator payouts or foreign-source MCN commission revenue from the annual return; invoicing through a related shell without actual services; making false statements in the tax return; claiming inflated deduction of management fees or creator payments to a related foreign entity without TP support; understating the Colombian-source service revenues to shift profit to a zero-tax jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalty of imprisonment 6 to 12 years and a fine of 200% to 1,000% of the evaded tax (Art. 402 Código Penal). Administrative penalty: the more severe of (i) 160% of the omitted tax; (ii) 20% of omitted taxable income; or (iii) 20% of net assets when the return omits assets. Additional default interest; dissolution/termination of the legal entity may be ordered by DIAN for repeated infractions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, the legal representative, and the tax accountant (revisor fiscal if required) are jointly and severally liable for penalties and tax debt when they sign a false declaration or knowingly cause the omission (Art. 793 E.T.). Colombian courts disregard the S.A.S. limited liability veil when the entity is used as a sham to evade taxes or defraud creditors (Arts. 36-1 and 36-2 of Law 1429/2010 and judicial doctrine). Directors may face travel bans (prohibición de salida del país), asset embargo, extradition to Colombia, and criminal incarceration for evasion. Personal liability extends to fines and interest, notwithstanding the entity's dissolution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Economic Substance Abuse (Empresa ficticia, testaferro, abuse of S.A.S. limited liability)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using a Colombian S.A.S. exclusively as a booking shell, without office, employees, contracts, or management substance, to receive TikTok MCN revenues and route them to a foreign principal or to launder the appearance of a local operation; failing to file or maintaining nominee shareholders who are merely straw men for foreign beneficial owners.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN may recharacterize the entity as a mere agent/conduit and tax the foreign principal directly in Colombia; penalties up to 200% of the tax assessment; cancellation of the commercial registry; criminal charges for money laundering (Arts. 323-325 Código Penal) if the shell is used to conceal the origin, location, or movement of funds, with imprisonment of 9 to 15 years and fines up to 50,000 SMLMV under Colombian asset-laundering statutes (Law 1762/2015).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The nominee director and foreign beneficial owner are jointly liable for criminal penalties; the corporate veil is pierced, making the foreign principal directly liable for Colombian tax, interest, and penalties. Directors face personal embargo of assets, 5-to-12-year prison terms, travel bans, and disqualification from holding office in Colombia. Real beneficiary disclosure obligations under Law 2155/2021 impose personal liability on the legal representative for inaccurate beneficial ownership reporting.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Anti-Money Laundering Deficiencies in Cross-border Creator Payments (Riesgos LA/FT, Circular Básica Jurídica, Decree 83/2023)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving TikTok creator payouts from multiple jurisdictions, executing Wise B2B transfers to foreign creator accounts, or distributing creator earnings without performing risk-based customer due diligence (CDD), monitoring high-value transactions, or reporting cash/monetary transfers in excess of the threshold (US$10,000 or its equivalent in COP for currency transactions; monetary declaration for international transfers); opening or operating a bank account without the UBO (final beneficiary) registration; intentionally concealing the true creator-client relationship to evade sanctions screening.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines per infraction: up to 200% of the transaction value or 2,000 SMLMV (approx. COP 2,000 million); cancellation of electronic invoicing authorization; prohibition from acting as a financial service intermediary; suspension of commercial registration; in serious cases, criminal liability under money-laundering law (prison 9-15 years, fines up to 50,000 SMLMV); entity exclusion from the payment rails (TikTok and Wise may freeze or deplatform the agency’s account).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and the legal representative of the S.A.S. are criminally liable if the company's AML failures intentionally or negligently facilitate laundering or financing of terrorism. Personal asset freezes, travel bans, imprisonment, and disqualification from being a manager or director in any Colombian company for up to 10 years after criminal conviction. Additionally, civil liability for damages to creators or counterparties is not insurable for wilful misconduct.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Withholding / Collection Agent Default (Agente de retención incumplido, Arts. 371-1, 402 E.T.)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to withhold the statutory 35% dividend WHT, royalty WHT, interest WHT, or payroll withholding on creator sub-payments; making profit distributions to foreign shareholders without applying treaty procedures; under-withholding on payments to foreign TikTok contractors and falsely certifying that no withholding is due; failure to submit the monthly Form 350 or equivalent electronic declarations (declaración de retención).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalty for not collecting and paying withholdings is 100% of the uncollected amount plus interest; late filing penalties and imprisonment 6-12 years if the amount withheld but not paid exceeds a legally defined threshold; DIAN may freeze bank accounts and seize assets of the S.A.S. to satisfy the debt.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the legal representative are personally liable for withholding amounts that were actually deducted or collected but not paid over to the Treasury (Art. 402-1 E.T.); the liability is not dischargeable by bankruptcy; the DIAN may issue a travel ban and a precautory embargo against the director's personal assets. Criminal liability applies to the financial manager or whoever signed the withholding declaration.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Misreporting (Manipulación de precios de transferencia, Art. 260-10 E.T., Decree 2178/2017)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Charging an unarm’s length management fee to the foreign TikTok group/creator affiliate, or using a foreign affiliate located in a tax haven to invoice the MCN services with no actual economic activity; failing to file TP documentation or filing a generic/unsupported benchmark. No contemporaneous TP masterfile/localfile; intentionally selecting TNMM comparables with a loss margin while the related party earns abnormally high profit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN adjustment to taxable income plus penalty of 5% on the adjusted difference (for lack of documentation/support) and potential 100%–200% of the unreported tax; formal penalty for not filing informative TP return (up to 2,000 UVT per omission); interest on deficiencies. Criminal exposure if the TP misstatement reflects fraudulent intent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative and the person signing the TP disclosure are personally liable for false statements; the corporate veil can be pierced for sham transactions. Directors may be barred from managing entities for up to 10 years and face criminal prosecution for tax fraud.
